notes: v2 of the API (OWN gateway base path /realtime-product-search/v2 via own_slug; RapidAPI serves the same routes at the host root). /search and /deals: page-based, up to 40 products per page in data.products (limit only truncates a page). /product-offers and /product-price-history-v2: page-based, offers in data.offers. /product-reviews and /store-reviews: cursor-based (data.cursor), reviews in data.reviews.
